title: T37: Complete and adjudicate the visual development experiment
body:
**Parent:** #38

## Completed execution scope

The operator continued the already-running cost-ranked v5 experiment instead of switching to the subsequently proposed four-hour pilot. This ticket records completion and adjudication of that actual run. The 512-record/one-epoch pilot was not executed and is not claimed complete. Original comments and frozen receipts remain preserved.

Contract: `issue-75-visual-development-32k-v5`, run `outputs/visual_development/issue75-32k-v5/attempt-001`.

## Result

All four training runs and all 864 selected episodes completed in 76.23 hours. The retained outcome is **VALID_STOP**, `scientific_completion: false`, because BFWS learned success was 66.7%, below the frozen 80% threshold. This is complete experimental evidence with a failed performance gate. Closing the execution ticket does not turn that result into PASS or lower a threshold.

## Executed protocol

- 43,876 source training records across BFS, BFWS, additive w3 and additive greedy; two epochs; one training seed, 17; final adapters only.
- Cost-selected 42 development task groups / 54 algorithm-task cases, preserved across conditions.
- Five evaluation seeds (17, 29, 43, 71, 101); exact reference once per case. Counts: 54 exact-reference, 270 random-valid, 270 pretrained-base and 270 SFT episodes.
- Complete state/goal observations, bounded Search Memory, operation budgets and independent trace replay. Source corpus, original splits and freezes remain unchanged.
- Two GPUs with distinct MASTER_PORT values 18575 and 18576. Actual elapsed time is retained; no four-hour budget compliance is claimed.

## Completion criteria

- Verify all four final adapter files and complete task/algorithm/condition/seed membership.
- Independently replay all 864 episodes and reconcile the saved metrics and gate verdict without new model calls or rewriting original outputs.
- Report success, invalid operations, budget usage, learned-versus-control gains and uncertainty limitations, including negative findings and control saturation.
- Report actual elapsed time and available resource evidence honestly. Whole-run v5 peak memory was not saved; reused qualification memory is calibration evidence only.
- Preserve the failed scientific gate and do not rerun merely to obtain PASS. Distinguish completed execution from performance-gate success and from the unrun deadline pilot.
- Hand off the actual training scope to #76/#77 before matched-modality claims; do not automatically enlarge downstream compute.

## Findings and handoff

SFT success: BFS 100%, BFWS 66.7%, additive w3 100%, additive greedy 100%. Random-valid success: 70.7%, 52%, 100%, 100%, respectively. Exact references pass all cases; the base condition has 0% success and 100% invalid operations under the frozen protocol. Only BFS has a positive saved whole-instance bootstrap lower bound against its best control. Additive controls saturate. Five rollout seeds do not establish training-seed variance.

The planned 512-record/one-epoch #76 pilot is not training-matched to these v5 adapters. Reconcile scope before #76/#77/#93–#95 comparison claims, preserving existing future spending caps. No multimodal, DAgger, final-test, replication or transfer completion is implied.

Evidence: `docs/experiments/issue75/v5-completion.md` and `v5-completion-verification.json`. Original run evidence remains under the run directory above.

## Blocked by
#73 (completed prerequisite)

**Parent:** #38

<!-- DEADLINE-SCOPE-V1 -->
This deadline scope supersedes the older full-matrix, five-seed and approval-manifest requirements for this ticket. Use one training/evaluation seed (17), retain raw evidence and never treat incomplete coverage as a completed experiment.

## Actual #75 handoff — supersedes assumed pilot completion

#75 completed the cost-ranked v5 run: 43,876 training records across four algorithms, two epochs, training seed 17, five evaluation seeds and 864 episodes in 76.23 hours. The four-hour visual pilot was not run. The retained scientific gate is VALID_STOP (BFWS 66.7% < 80%) with complete selected coverage. See `docs/experiments/issue75/v5-completion.md`.

Before new GPU launches or matched-modality claims, reconcile this executed training scope with the planned 512-record/one-epoch multimodal/text pilots. Do not compare them as a controlled modality effect; filtering evaluation to common tasks alone cannot repair the training mismatch. Preserve the existing future compute caps and checkpoints. Do not automatically expand to multi-day replication or repeat #75. If a matched comparison cannot fit, report separate feasibility evidence and limitations through #77/#100 instead.

## Deadline status
Required development evidence for the deadline go/no-go decision.

## Budget
4 hours wall-clock total on the two A100s.

## What to do
First resolve the actual #75 handoff above, then implement only a bounded multimodal protocol whose comparison claims match its training and evaluation scope. The original pilot specification below is provisional until that reconciliation.

## Acceptance criteria
- Reuse the shared pilot membership and 512-record/one-epoch training schedule; do not recollect scenes or create a larger corpus.
- Qualify only the bounded pilot input shapes, scalar/batch semantics and adapter isolation for the actual multimodal processor. Visual-only timing is not multimodal qualification.
- Run base, process SFT, random-valid and exact-reference conditions on the same 12 algorithm/task cases (48 episodes).
- Keep complete text-image semantic parity and independent episode replay. Preserve partial evidence if time expires.
- Run after #75 on the two A100s, or explicitly allocate disjoint resources and adjust the schedule; never overlap two workers per GPU.

## Blocked by
#74

## Scheduling
Use at most one model worker per GPU, with distinct MASTER_PORT values. The two-GPU #75/#76 and #93/#94/#95 jobs must be serialized on the available two A100s. Timeouts retain evidence and stop new work; no automatic budget extension or repeat-until-positive runs.

The deadline roadmap is documented in docs/experiments/deadline-plan/README.md. Terms retain their meanings from CONTEXT.md.
